Nothing is running and nothing is waiting, so I made no changes this hour. All compute has been idle since 10-30 19:32, about 7.4 hours.

- **Resources:** CPU load is 3.1 (host has 256 cores; our quota is 32). Memory is 97.8 of 137 GB, but almost all of that is page cache; the processes themselves use about 1 GB. There have been no new out-of-memory kills. All 7 GPUs are at 0% use. The only GPU memory in use belongs to other users (weimin2 on GPU 0–2, thlin on GPU 5–6), and GPU 3 and 4 are empty.
- **Queues:**
  - Old FEBio queue: 0 waiting, 0 running, 2046 done, 2 failed. The last run finished 10-30 19:25.
  - New task queue: 0 waiting, 0 running, 1 done, 5 failed (the gate2 tasks from 10-28).
- **Services:** all are up. The three one-time jobs in `ops/resume_all.sh` (physio_v3, physio_rot, rot_chain) have their finished markers, so nothing needs restarting. Every long job is covered after a server restart.
- **Problem found:** the old repo's watchdog (h23) restarts the active-learning loop `biocage_al_loop` every 5 minutes. Each time, the loop stops at once because it has already reached its limit of 150 points. That is 1444 restarts since 10-22. It uses no compute but fills the logs. Changing the watchdog is outside what I'm allowed to edit, so I listed it as a request.

**Needs a person:**
1. The science roles need to queue the next batch of work. Six physio_rot designs are still below target: p052, p061, p093, p100, p123, p145.
2. Someone needs to decide what to do with the 5 failed gate2 tasks.
3. /raid is full, with only 21 GB free. Space should be cleared before any large batch.
4. The watchdog should stop restarting the finished loop.

Files are in `work/agents/foreman/`: `report_20261031_0255.md` and the updated `status.json`. I also added one line to `work/ops/foreman_actions.log`.
